parts.text: The huddle had twenty-two archetypes — but the company's own fleet had a dozen real faces with no persona file at all.
So we wrote them: thirteen company-os-live personas, in the exact huddle format, each with a real scar — aliases deduped.
Thirty-five personas now — the archetypes plus the full live roster, from the trading desks to the builders.
And the validator agrees: sixty-seven checks green. Every file has its frontmatter, its signature phrases, its disagreements, a real scar, and a roster entry — with no alias duplicated.
